name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, locate your home's main water shutoff and identify where existing plumbing stacks and electrical panels are located. Measure candidate spaces if you are considering an interior conversion, such as an under-stair cupboard or spare bedroom corner. Determine your primary priorities: whether you need a quick powder room for entertaining or a full guest suite bath. Having an idea of preferred fixtures, such as walk-in showers versus bathtubs, also helps your contractor assess space requirements immediately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Locate your main water line and electrical panel, decide if you need a half or full bath, note fixture preferences, and identify candidate spaces in your floor plan.
